entity.name: apportionment
entity.comment: NC apportionment entity for multi-state tax calculation. Used by decision tables 7000-7500 for multi-state tax apportionment and NC-specific tables 51200-51299. NC has the LOWEST state corporate income tax rate in the nation at 2.5%. Key Features: Flat 2.5% corporate income tax rate (NC General Statute § 105-130.3), Single-sales apportionment formula, Economic nexus: $100,000 gross receipts threshold, No alternative minimum tax, No special surcharges. References: NC General Statute § 105-130.3 (Tax rate), NC Form CD-405 (Corporation Income Tax Return), NC Department of Revenue Corporate Income Tax Bulletins.

field.name: economic_nexus_threshold
field.comment: NC economic nexus gross receipts threshold: $100,000

field.name: transaction_threshold
field.comment: NC economic nexus transaction count threshold: 200 transactions

field.name: apportionment_formula
field.comment: NC uses single-sales factor apportionment (100% sales factor)

field.name: state_tax_rate
field.comment: NC corporate income tax rate: 2.5% (LOWEST state rate in the nation) - NC Gen. Stat. § 105-130.3

field.name: state_additions
field.comment: NC additions: federal interest income, certain expenses, IRC 199A addback, etc.

field.name: state_subtractions
field.comment: NC subtractions: NC municipal bond interest, state income taxes, state NOL, etc.

field.name: state_credits
field.comment: NC tax credits: jobs creation, film production, renewable energy, historic preservation, etc.

entity.name: result
entity.comment: NC result entity. North Carolina uses a straightforward flat-rate system without: Alternative minimum tax, Special surcharges, Industry-specific tax rates, Combined reporting complexity (though unitary rules apply). No NC-specific fields required.
